result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭軸負向 finding（competitive_share_entrants#1、#2）已分別進 threats 與 blind_spots，Uber 提告、10-K 自承轉換成本低也有處理；應收帳款 12% 的單一實體在 q1 有交代。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"supply_demand_durability 軸沒有負向 finding；judgment 仍寫了需求結構性持久、Dasher 供給可逆性高但受勞動法規約束，並把後果接進 bear 與 Single Thing。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"反壟斷、Dasher 身分與 EDD 評定、關稅、地緣、Q4 指引、替代技術、訴訟等負向 finding 都被 threats、blind_spots、triggers 或 R1–R6 引用，沒有接不住的軸。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.wait_for_price","reason":"oneliner 與 rearm 寫「等週線站回 104 週均線再進」，wait_for_price 與 wait_for_price_condition 卻是 null；裁決為觀望，所以不算矛盾，條件本身（200.5 美元、連 4 週、EBITDA ≥9 億）具體可驗，market_wrong_reason_given=false 與 valuation_dependent=false 一致。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.verdict_values.bargaining","reason":"customer_second_source 為 not_applicable，查詢詞（商家自營配送／second source）切題；customer_concentration_credit 軸已有證據且被引用，沒有核心軸缺口需要補交代。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.roic_durability","reason":"roiic、reinvest_rate 寫「事實表未涵蓋」、endo_ceiling 為 null，屬資料缺口且已在 q3 寫明按「超出上界」處理；情境樹價差實質（Bull 18.8／Base 15.2／Bear 8.0），526.4／128／EV +69.3%／IRR 12.1% 我重算與 scenario_meta 對得上。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.fact_refs","reason":"營運指標都用 Q3 FY2026（2026-09-30）口徑，算式驗得過（單筆訂單、take rate 13.6%、SBC 5.8%／61%）；賣方目標價是 9 月初資料，judgment 已自標過時。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"前份有值的欄位只有 signal、val、ma、trap、price_at_dd；trap 🟢→🟡 有「新證據」條目且理由站得住，price_at_dd 與 ma 有程式歸因，signal 與 val 不變，其餘前份為 null 不計。"}]
